171000.description:
Sora Tanaka works at a rural grocery store while quietly doing online voice acting. One afternoon while returning to work from her break, Sora's apron string gets caught in the door behind her as she's updating her social media account. Just then, the chatty and puppy - dog - like delivery man Seita Minamino happens to walk by the break room and catch Sora as she falls. Her phone plops on her chest and Seita notices she's his favorite online voice actor, Manako Kumori!!

In an attempt to wrap her head around everything, Sora invites Seita to a restaurant later, but the conversation turns towards her latest gig and the two somehow end up in a hotel...!?

So begins intense vocal training between the 1000% cute but super socially anxious geek Sora and the overly chatty and puppy - dog like Seita

(Source: Renta!)

title.english: Let Me Hear Manako's Voice Again
title.native: プリーズリピートラブリーボイス

171001.description:
Ao Minato, a young man who murders his stepfather who repeatedly abused his family, ends up in a juvenile detention center. However, the sister he was supposed to protect commits suicide due to her suffering, and their older sister Akane has gone missing.

Ao arrives at a certain shrine and prays for his sister's safety, his only hope, and vows to the god that he will do anything for that, but...

The blockbuster panic suspense "Gyakusatsu Happy End". The new chapter has finally begun.

(Source: Young Animal Web, translated, edited)
synonyms: Massacre Happy End: The Blue Chapter

title.native: 虐殺ハッピーエンド～蒼の章～
title.romaji: Gyakusatsu Happy End : Ao no Shou

171003.description:
Pei Yucheng had been possessing Lin Yan to get back at anyone who gave her a hard time, but once he left, she forgot what happened. Soon, Lin Yan found out about the possession, at the cost of her repeated sexual harassment of Pei Yucheng...

What the hell? The whole thing was staged? What should I do? Emergency!

(Source: Webnovel)
synonyms: Sweet and Warm With You for the Rest of My Life
There Are You in My Remaining Life, Both Sweet and Warm
イケメン社長に憑依されました

title.romaji: Yu Sheng You Ni, Tian You Nuan

171004.description:
Haku Yaesaki is a bored high school student with no direction in life. Right as he starts noticing how all his friends have dreams they are striving for, he meets pro golfer hopeful Nadeshiko Oga and his empty life begins to change. Now, it's time to find a whole new you as this golfing adventure tees off!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title.native: グリーングリーングリーンズ
今日の私は毛穴まで可愛い!!
title.romaji: Kyou no Watashi wa Keana Made Kawaii!!

171007.description:
Shigaraki is prone to tantrums, and his unpredictable behavior causes him to be an outsider in his class. One day, model student Shimizu peeks at Shigaraki's clay art piece during arts and crafts and is immediately captivated by it. This event leads to him becoming obsessed with Shigaraki's creations.

(Source: K Manga)

title.native: どくだみの花咲くころ

171008.description:
R19 side story to To Catch a Falling Star.

Note: Chapter count includes an extra chapter.

171009.description:
Nan Baoyi was born into a well-off family, but she married poorly, and died destitute. When she was reborn, she set her sights on a lowly adopted boy, knowing that the unwanted young man has a bright future ahead of him. But he seemed uninterested in all of her advances. Just as she was about to give up and find herself another man, now that he is a powerful minister, he suddenly annulled her arranged marriage, and called her to his silken bed, "come here baby, I'm all yours…"

(Source: Tencent, translated)
synonyms: After Rebirth, I Became a Powerful Minister’s Beloved

title.english: After Rebirth, I Became a Powerful Ministers Beloved
title.native: 重生后我成了权臣的掌中娇
title.romaji: Chongsheng Hou Wo Chengle Quan Chen de Zhang Zhong Jiao

171010.description:
Staro Lee was confined at the basement for five years, cheated and tortured by her fiance. This monster killed her four brothers and stole her family property. At the brink of death, a voice told her that she was granted another chance to change her fate. Then Staro Lee became Miss Goofy. With the scheme unfolding, a man she never met at the last life showed up, Gison Soong, an aloof CEO with a mysterious curse... No matter what reason that the fate brought this man here, Staro determined to clean everyone who got in the way of her vengeance.

(Source: MangaToon)
synonyms: The Wicked Girl Is Arriving Tonight
Esta Noite Sucede a Senhorita Vingança
Đêm Nay Ác Nữ Giáng Lâm
復讐のためなら悪女にでもなる

171011.description:
I want to be sweetly embraced like a cherished treasure for my first time. That's when I thought to call a male escort service and make my dreams come true. What I got was a nightmare instead! Ryota would be the call boy who took my virginity, full throttle and nothing like how I wanted my first time to be. To make matters worse, turns out he's a student at my university. Wanting to try my luck again, I call the same escort service only to be sent Ryota a second time. Somehow he manages to make up for the last time and gives me the "sweet lover's special" I've always wanted...?! Love grows in between the lines of aloofness and passion on this clumsy heart-throbbing pendulum.

(Source: MangaPlaza)

171012.description:
In Yu Wan's eyes, Ni Shang is a bitch who has been her arch-nemesis since childhood. The only reason she accepted an internship at Ni Shang's company was because her father threatened to force her to give up her dreams of becoming a dancer. Trying to annoy Ni Shang in any way she can, Yu Wan claimed she was a lesbian to scare her away.

But why is Ni Shang looking at me so strangely all of a sudden? And why is her hands all over me?

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes 5 extras.

title.native: 宿敌看我的眼神逐渐变质
title.romaji: Sudi Kan Wo De Yanshen Zhujian Bianzhi

171013.description:
On a hot, humid, and rainy day like this, I think of you.

(Source: BE×BOY, translated)

171014.description:
A vivid short story depicting a dazzling but painful love!

(Source: BE×BOY, translated)

171015.description:
One day, "disaster" struck, destroying the town and killing Cruz and his sister Artie. However, Cruz woke up to see a dark elf girl named Enju. She asks Cruz, "Do you want your life to end like this, or will you become a god to fight off the 'disaster'?"

(Source: Comic Nova, translated)

title.native: 黒エルフに飼われた俺のダンジョン生活~三食風呂と地獄つき~
title.romaji: Kuro Elf ni Kawareta Ore no Dungeon Seikatsu: Sanshoku Furo to Jigokutsuki

171020.description:
"Excuse me, I was raised without manners. Prepare yourself, milady."

Ava is a noblewoman known as the "Ice Flower" for her cold and haughty attitude. When her engagement was rudely annulled in public, Guy, a handsome and successful merchant, unexpectedly asks her to marry him instead! It is a proposal for a contractual marriage in which both parties' interests are aligned. Ava, who is strong-willed but actually quite naive, gets angry when Guy says he does not expect affection, and she declares, "We can become a loving couple and make each other happy!" That was when he kisses her fiercely. When he whispers love to her with a sweet voice and takes her for the first time, her frozen heart and body will melt into a hot puddle...?

(Source: Brite, translated)

title.native: 婚約破棄された悪役令嬢、イケメン資産家に求婚されました。
title.romaji: Konyaku Haki sareta Akuyaku Reijou, Ikemen Shisanka ni Kyuukonsaremashita.

171021.description:
Chris-sama, the Ice Lady, is the villainess of a fantasy novel. I've been trying my best to help her avoid the inevitable breakup and other doom flags. But she says she wants to be my sex slave! Her first experience is sex-training at a cheap inn! She climaxes in a dungeon and gets covered in semen! She wants to be dominated, my pure and innocent slave. The adventure story of an innocent but naughty lady slave and her isekai-reincarnated servant-master!

(Source: Bishoujo Bunko, translated)

title.native: 悪役令嬢ですが、私をあなたの性奴隷にしてください！
title.romaji: Akuyaku Reijou desu ga, Watashi wo Anata no Seidorei ni Shite Kudasai!

171022.description:
The Crown Prince publicly announces that their engagement is annulled and that she is to be banished. My efforts as the villainess's servant were in vain. Now she who could not avoid the doom flag, is telling me that she wants to become my sex slave! "Take my virginity! I am your sex slave. Fill my baby-room with your seed!" The young lady who was known as the "Ice Lady," her face twisted with pleasure, is begging me to come inside her, her hymen broken on a bed in a cheap inn. That haughty aristocratic noblewoman is as good as dead. Now I'm resolved to give her the best first-experience possible. I told her, "Oh, God! I'm going to come inside you! I'm going to make you my sex slave, just as you wish!" This is the story of Kite, a reincarnated squire who knew her doomed fate, and Chris, a villainess lady who becomes a happy sex slave.

(Source: Rush! Z, translated)
synonyms: I may be a Villainess, But Please Make Me Your Sex Slave!

title.english: I Am a Villainess but Please Make Me Your Sex Slave!
title.native: 悪役令嬢ですが、私をあなたの性奴隷にしてください！
title.romaji: Akuyaku Reijou desu ga, Watashi wo Anata no Seidorei ni Shite Kudasai!

171023.description:
Takasaki Hanashiro is a junior high girl who is also a busy entrepreneur. She is a rational thinker with a super science brain. When she finds a dirty man...... slumped over in a garbage dump, she ends up taking him in. But the young man turns out to be ridiculously handsome, and he wants to live with her as a housekeeper...?

(Source: Kurofune Pixiv, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes one bonus chapter.
synonyms: The 14 year old president picks up the NEET

171024.description:
A high-school boy Sandai, who liked to spend his time alone, accidentally helped the most beautiful girl in his class, Shino, when she fell into a ditch near his home. He let her use shower at his home, and lend her some clothes, although he had never talked with her before. From that day, she started to act like his friend. In fact, she seems to like him...but that can't be! She's the most popular babe in his high school! But what he didn't know was, Shino had never went out with a guy. She was not very good with guys, and Sandai was the first guy she could talk naturally with. As they spend time together, Sandai can't help himself to have special feelings for Shino.

A story of a boy whose life was completely changed by a cute babe!

(Source: KADOKAWA Global)
synonyms: The Gal Sitting Behind Me Likes Me.: Maybe I'm Screwed Already.
The gal is sitting behind me, and loves me.

title.english: The Babe at My Back Has Her Eye on Me. I'm Done For.
title.native: うしろの席のぎゃるに好かれてしまった。　もう俺はダメかもしれない。
title.romaji: Ushiro no Seki no Gal ni Sukarete Shimatta.: Mou Ore wa Damekamoshirenai.

171027.description:
Chinatsu didn't expect to be dropped from the project she enjoyed working on and transferred to a small, related company. On her first day at the new office, Chinatsu starts talking to a man sitting next to her. Suddenly, her boss asks her if she can see the man, Genki. Her new division is in charge of projects that no other divisions do. Many people call the division the "Haunting Department," and Genki is a ghost. Chinatsu goes with her boss and Genki to check a unit where strange things happen. Genki is a nice guy, and Chinatsu ends up asking him to live with her...

(Source: Anime News Network)
synonyms: 八坂不動産的不平凡日常我開始跟幽靈同居了。

title.english: Just Another Peculiar Day at Yasaka Real Estate: Now I Live With a Ghost
title.native: 八坂不動産管理の訳アリな日常 幽霊と同居、始めました。
title.romaji: Yasaka Fudousan Kanri no Wakeari na Nichijou Yuurei to Doukyo, Hajimemashita.

171028.description: Lin Mo was goofing off playing games in the middle of class, when he was unexpectedly transported to another world infested with ghosts and monsters. Although he wasn't given any talents, he accidentally stumbled upon the “Defense-Breaking System.” All he had to do was break through a ghost’s defenses, and BAM! he could force it into a contract of servitude. Now things can get wild! Other people had contracts with two ghost at most. Lin Mo went all out and contracted MILLIONS of ghosts! With a single summon, thousands of ghosts will descend on his enemy! Drowned ghosts, hungry ghosts, drunken ghosts, chainsaw ghosts… Spooky, right?! Boo-tifully terrifying!
synonyms: Global Ghost, Billions of Ghosts Inside Me!
Global Ghost Control: There Are Hundreds of Millions of Ghosts in My Body
Global Ghosts Warden: I have 100 million Contracted Ghosts

title.native: 全球御鬼：我的体内有亿只鬼
title.romaji: Quan Qiu Yu Gui: Wo De Ti Nei You Yi Zhi Gui

171032.description:
Kaikaiin Seika, an environmental scientist at Tokyo University of Science, is an ardent environmentalist who prioritizes research over love. But that is her daytime face. At night she has another face... as a legendary call girl! Numerous customers line up with offers to behold her beauty. Whenever a mysterious man called "Agent" sends her a job, she dresses up in a bewitching dress and goes out into the night... However, Seika isn't just a call girl working for money. Her real goal is to punish those powerful people who cause environmental destruction! For those who are doing damage to the Earth, she becomes an assassin who gives death as well as pleasure! A new kind of heroine who fights for the Earth day and night! Don't miss this new kind of sexy gekiga manga for the environmental age!

(Source: Nihonbungeisha, translated)

171033.description:
This is an anthology where everyone gets beaten up!

(Source: Toranoana, translated)

title.native: ぜんぶまとめてボコボコりんっ!

171034.description:
Hadekawa Iyone failed her high school debut as a wannabe gal. Desperately trying to break out from her outcast status, she tries talking to the girl sitting next to her, Chisui Makuru, who turns out to be the vampire rumored about town! Although Makuru isn't like your typical vampire... And thus begins the slightly strange high school life of a gal in search of a friend, and a vampire in search of an underling.

(Source: NicoNico Seiga, translated)
171034.hashtag: #ギャルとネクラの吸血関係
synonyms: The bloody relationship between Nekura and Gal

title.native: ギャルとネクラの吸血関係
title.romaji: Gyaru to Nekura no Kyuuketsu Kankei

171035.description:
The official spin-off of Inazuma Eleven is kicking off! Entertaining from the heart, depicting the daily casual life of Shuya Goenji, known as the "Ace Striker of Fire"! What is the always cool Gouenji thinking?

(Source: Manga-5)

title.native: ほのスト！ ～豪炎寺のひとりごと～

171039.description: Compilation of cat manga published by Nobara Nonaka in *Neko no Akubi* magazine.

171042.description:
Miku has a reputation at work as a "solitary beauty"' and "a haughty flower." But she doesn't want to be called that, she just wanted to be herself...! While thinking about it, she does something unexpected with the "thing" she kept in her bag. She couldn't believe she was seen by a junior colleague!!!

That nostalgic taste of childhood, Even though she's all grown up, it still brings her happiness...

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

171044.description:
What’s the chance of running into your first love again after twelve years? This is exactly what happens to Solhui after attending her frenemy’s bridal shower. What’s more? Her first love is having an affair with a married woman. But that’s not all. She meets him and the woman again when she starts a viola lesson with a new student.

(Source: WEBTOON)

171045.description:
Desperate to escape the streets after being discarded by his parents, Flynn finds hope at Willow City Necromancy Academy. There, his hidden spirit talents ignite. Crushing specters and gaining powerful spirit allies, Flynn eclipses his peers. Hailed as a prodigy, Flynn harbors a secret ambition: to become the strongest necromancer fueled by revenge from those who cast him out. As a specter horde marches, can the vengeful prodigy become a hero, or will his fury consume him?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: ゴースト・エイジ～最強鬼霊を操る俺は世界を制する～

title.romaji: Quan Qiu Gui Yi Shi Dai

title.native: ドラスティックサマーバケーション
セノビガシタイオトシゴロ
ラブライブ！スクールアイドルフェスティバルALL STARS イベントメモリー
title.romaji: Love Live! School Idol Festival All Stars : Event Memory

171052.description:
A high school girl with a mature body wrote "Sensei's wife" as her future career aspiration!?

This student who's also a little bit calculating, gets him to sow his seed into her as a means of accepting her straightforward "love"!

(Source: DLsite, translated) Published in COMIC Koh 2016-07

title.native: ヘブンバーンズレッド コミックアンソロジー

171054.description:
Her husband's debts and subsequent suicide, her own illness and suicide attempt, being an AV actress and various other jobs...

The author, who had led a tumultuous life, meets and falls in love at the age of 36 with Bobby, who was 25 years her senior. She and Bobby, full of spirit, live a happy life, even though they fought a lot.

Then one day, a big incident occurs...

Age difference, past trauma, schizophrenia, facial disfigurement, blindness......

This is a moving comic essay that humorously depicts the daily life of two people who love each other while trying to overcome life's challenges!　

(Source: East Press, translated)

171055.description:
Disfigured and blinded from jumping off a pedestrian bridge...
Trying to live with schizophrenia.
Four and a half years since the events of Ningen Kakuninchuu, Bobby is still there to support me.

Every reader wanted to know, what happened to our lives afterwards?

The feelings are intense, unconventional, but pure.
More resilient than anyone, and no one could ever imitate it.
"Our story of love and adventure" will now be revealed!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

171056.description:
I’m... back! After a comet collides on Earth, a gaming world filled with monsters and dungeons becomes a reality. Amidst the chaos, Won-Ho wakes up as Hardcore Leveling Warrior, an almighty game character with exceptional luck and power. Once again, he will embark on a journey to become the strongest... but this time, on Earth!

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

title.native: メドゥーサ奴隷を買った

171058.description:
Tatsumi Yagasaki, a workaholic writer worn down by life, is forced to assist prince Nico of the Kingdom of Rashid, who came to Japan to write a guidebook about the country. Tatsumi is exhausted from being at the mercy of the prince all day long, but he's swayed by Nico's honest and naive smile. Before he realizes it, he gets drunk and sleeps with him. While Nico is somehow both happy and embarrassed, Tatsumi is terrified that he might be in for severe punishment! An old custom dictates that Nico must spend the rest of his life with the one who takes his virtue, so Tatsumi is set to be his spouse!

This is a love story between a divorced man nearing his forties and a prince that transcends status and country!

(Source: Renta!)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: The Prince's Companion Is Batsuichi Around 40

title.english: The Prince's Spouse Is A Divorcee Pushing Forty
title.native: 王子様の伴侶はバツイチアラフォー
title.romaji: Ouji-sama no Hanryo wa Batsuichi Arafou

171059.description:
I tried confessing my feelings to Nao, the smart, beautiful, and athletic girl with cat ears who sat next to me, but she shot me down with a single sentence: "Who are you?" and I was crushed. The next day, I came up with the idea to "forcibly assault her and making her my own" like how they do it in hentai manga! However, when I actually pushed her down, I was so close to her that I was taken back, and Nao cheekily challenged me, "Why don't you just go ahead and fuck me?" I was so embarrassed that I couldn't help but pull away as I angrily told her how I felt about her, but her attitude didn't change, only her tail is wagging happily...!

(Source: Melonbooks, translated)

171061.description:
When he entered high school, "Youthful Exuberance" was added to the subject list. It is a world where how you live your youth has become a criteria for higher education and for getting a job.

Issei Hanayama just wants to live a "normal" life, while Kazutoshi Suzuki, his childhood friend, wants to be a model "youth." On their first day of school, they get into a fight and end their friendship. Some are at the mercy of the evaluation system, some surrender to it, and some challenge it.... A tragi-comic high school life begins―!?

(Source: Shodensha, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes three volume-bonus chapters and the original one-shot version.

171062.description:
"Home is where the heart is."

Today, once again, the day sprawls out before us. Happy days, and not-so-happy days - no matter what, here at home you're always wrapped in the warmth of your favorite place. It's the little things: the small joys, scattered all about, that make everyday life worth living.

A full-color collection of vignettes about daily life at home, presented by popular illustrator Ida Chiaki.

Content list:
- Prologue (プロローグ)
- 1-kenme: Sasa-san Taku (1軒目 ササさん宅)
- 2-kenme: Kae-san Taku (2軒目 カエさん宅)
- 3-kenme: Nanako-san Taku (3軒目 ナナコさん宅)
- 4-kenme: Midori-san Taku (4軒目 ミドリさん宅)
- 5-kenme: Akira-san Taku (5軒目 アキラさん宅)
- Epilogue (エピローグ)

171063.description:
What will be the fate of these unpopular ghost-hunting YouTubers!?

(Source: Comic Beam, translated)

title.native: もらったアダルトグッズが気持ち良すぎてレポどころじゃなくなった話
title.romaji: Moratta Adult Goods ga Kimochi Yo Sugite Repo Dokoro ja Nakunatta Hanashi

title.native: 見た目は可愛いのに威力半端ない大人のおもちゃに出会ったレポ漫画
title.romaji: Mitame wa Kawaii noni Iryoku Hanpanai Otona no Omocha ni Deatta Repo Manga

171068.description:
When college student U-Yun meets the quiet and introverted TA Jin-Hyeong, he immediately asks him out, saying he wants to get to know him more. After just three days of dating, Jin-Hyeong moves in with him, and that’s when he starts showing a completely different wild side. All of his BL novel and comic consumption has perverted his perception of the perfect first time with his boyfriend. He’s thought of it all, from doing it in the subway to having U-Yun role-play as a K-pop idol. But as weird as Jin-Hyeong’s ideas are, U-Yun doesn’t entirely hate it...?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title.native: 一騎当千オフィシャルアンソロジー

171071.description:
Challenge. Again and again. Until your heart is broken. In order to rekindle the life of the lost, the harsh and merciless mountains of the underworld. A horrifying dark survival tale with overwhelming power.

(Source: Cycomi, translated)

171072.description:
Mamarin, a cheerful 89-year-old mother from Osaka, lives alone. The weather was nice, she went for a walk, and on the day she bought a bottle of shampoo, Mamarin's life changed dramatically. It all started with one small thing...

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

title.native: 母と同居で介護したらお互いエライ目にあった話
title.romaji: Haha to Doukyou de Kaigo Shitara Otagai Erai Me ni Atta Hanashi

171074.description:
Nagisa is a third-year middle school girl whose life revolves around the super popular idol Wataya Reina. When her hair gets cut short during spring break, she is mistaken for a member of the boy group Dai-Ly... What's more, even though she's a girl, she ends up filling in as a substitute for a missing member...?!

The fan takes the stage! The exciting story of a substitute idol!!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

Note: Includes six extra chapters.

title.native: 皇帝陛下の専属司書姫
title.romaji: Koutei Heika no Sensoku Shisho Hime

title.native: 皇帝陛下の専属司書姫 攻略対象に恋人契約されています!
title.romaji: Koutei Heika no Senzoku Shisho Hime: Kouryaku Taishou ni Koibito Keiyaku Sareteimasu!

171077.description:
Yousuke, a university student, lives together with his senior from the same hometown, Tsukiya.
As an infectious disease spreads and everyone is forced to stay home, Yosuke comes up with an idea and ropes Tsukiya into launching a "problem-solving website."
Requests trickle in one by one—the mystery of a withered morning glory, the odd habits of a newlywed husband, the reason a book-loving girlfriend gave up her books—everyday mysteries that they begin to solve.
As they untangle these puzzles, the hidden pasts of the two gradually come to light.

"I wish the world would just end already."

(What can I do to stop you?)

Tsukiya begins to plan the "perfect crime," and Yousuke wants to stop him.
Where will their clashing intentions ultimately lead them?

(Source: To Books, translated)

Note: Includes 3 extras.

title.native: 死にたがりの完全犯罪と部屋に降る七時前の雨@COMIC
title.romaji: Shinitagari no Kansen Hanzai to Heya ni Furu Nanaji Maz no Ame @COMIC

171078.description:
Ritsu Nagara is a new first-year member of the Mizusawa High School karuta club. For some reason, Ritsu is aiming to win the national championship, but after Chihaya and her friends graduate, the Mizusawa Karuta Club has only one A-class player, and he has a difficult time ahead of him... The story depicts Ritsu's growth along with his eccentric friend Akino and the other members of the club who are dedicated to playing karuta.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title.native: ちはやふる plus きみがため

171079.description:
In the year 20XX, Japan was in decline because of falling birth rates. To prevent Japan from dying out, it was decided that girls who reached a determined age would be allocated to single men. "Please make a baby with me..." says Suika, a girl who is shy but has a strong sense of responsibility, to Hedeki, a disappointing recluse who aspired to be a novelist. Under this unprecedented national policy, the two begin their stimulating life together!

(Source: Square-Enix, translated)

171081.description:
Kasane are spirits who latch onto the shadows of people's hearts. But as long as Yayoi and Aoba are around, evil spirits won't be hurting any students at the school! Beautiful art and occult action! The door to the unknown has now been opened...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

171082.description:
A series mass-murders where 15-year-old boys have slaughtered their own families. Iori Takigawa is a 15-year old boy who often dreams that he has become a monster and kills his family. And in those dreams, there is always a girl floating in the air... At school, Iori hears a rumor from Imazeki, the son of the police commissioner, about the truth behind the incidents. It seems that in each case, the 15-year-old boy suddenly transforms into a monster and attacks his family. On his way home that day, Iori and his friend Kikuchi are attacked by a group of delinquents. Suddenly, Kikuchi transforms into a giant monster, fights off the delinquents, and then turns on Iori…

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title.native: 獣星記 ギルステイン

171083.description:
1. 10-gatsu no Seraphim (１０月のセラフィーヌ)
2. Elektra (エレクトラ)
3-5. Hoffmann Monogatari (ホフマン物語)

171084.description:
Friends, lovers, fashion, and hanging out after-school... For Ouka Hoshino, a gal who grew up in the city, those are the important things in life. But when she unexpectedly had to move to Yutakamachi, a town in the countryside, she loses everything she held dear...? The tender days of youth gets a fresh start in an unfamiliar town!

(Source: Gene Pixiv, translated)

171085.description:
A collection of award-winning and unpublished works by Souichirou Yamamoto.

1. Romantic
2. Kono Natsu
3. Ha wa Ue ni Nageru Mono
4. Bokura no Yuujou Senki
5. Suzuki to Ooyama
6. Boku to Boku no Aniki

title.native: ロマンチック－山本崇一朗（裏）短編集－

171086.description:
One day, Liu Hai unexpectedly finds a beat-up book of magic. When she tries to draw a magic circle from the book, she accidentally summons a monster girl named Chi Xiaoliu. Xiaoliu has been imprisoned to provide the source of power for the Kingdom of Chi. She had wanted to escape for a long time and finally succeeded in escaping, just as Liu Hai was drawing the magical circle in the human world… and that's how the two girls met.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

171087.description:
Marina is on her way home after a night out. However, at the bus stop, she runs into a drunken woman, the former class rep from her high school days. Marina figures she wouldn't remember her, but while Marina is taking care of her, she drunkenly says, "Why did you use to avoid me...," in a deeply meaningful way?

(Source: Tonari no Young Jump, translated)

title.native: ギャルと委員長が偶然再会する話
title.romaji: Gal to Iinchou ga Guuzen Saikai Suru Hanashi

171088.description:
Ako Yamada, once a member of the most fiendish organization of assassins "Orochi", is living as an ordinary girl working at the Piping Hot Bakery. As an assassin, she was evil, cold-blooded, cruel, scary. The epitome of a hitman! However, she was extremely clumsy when it came to normal life! She was struggling to live as a teen girl working at a bakery, for she had lived too many years in the underworld. When Nono Morino, a high school girl who loves urban legends, came to the bakery to check on the rumor that a hitman is living somewhere around here, Ako did her best not to look suspicious. But not only her but also the members of Orochi were after Ako. Can she live a peaceful life she had longed for many years?!

(Source: Kadokawa)

title.native: となりの殺し屋ちゃん
魔王様と砂時計～転生したら妖精さんで将来の魔王に病まれる話～
title.romaji: Maou-sama to Suna Tokei : Tensei Shitara Yousei-san de Shourai no Maou ni Yamareru Hanashii

synonyms: Until My Childhood Friend, A Female Knight, Becomes The Queen

title.native: 幼馴染の女騎士が王女になるまで
title.romaji: Osananajimi no Onna Kishi ga Oujo ni Naru Made

171095.description: Note: Published in COMIC Magnum X Vol. 29,30

title.native: 女教師に息子が求める男女の関係
title.romaji: Onna Kyoushi ni Musuko ga Motomeru Danjo no Kankei

171096.description: In the Tohoku region's Akita prefecture, enveloped by Ouu's mountains there is a village with spectacular nature and snow 6 months of the year. This is Oraga Mura, Our village. Here the villagers live every day feeling loneliness, weariness, uncertainty, desire, tumult, expectations, and dreams. We are told these stories and experience the wonderful four season through the respected Takayama family.

171097.description:
When she heard the words "Ugh, villainess" thrown at her by another girl talking to her childhood friend and fiancé, Prince Soundik, it triggered memories of Duchess Natasha's previous life. In her previous life, Natasha must have read many romance novels and played many otome games, but she cannot remember which one is set in this world. Confused, she tries to get away in order to avoid the bad ending, but that only seems to accelerate the prince's doting love…!

A grand romantic fantasy about a reincarnated villainess who is a good cook, and her childhood friend, a selfish prince who only wants her to himself.

(Source: Comic ZeroSum, translated)
synonyms: Jamamono Youdesuga, Ouji no Chushoku ha Watashi ga Tsukuruyoudesu

title.native: 邪魔者のようですが、王子の昼食は私が作るようです
title.romaji: Jamamo no You desu ga, Ouji no Chuushoku wa Watashi ga Tsukuru You desu

171098.description:
A young woman is talking to Prince Soundik. Her words evokes memories of Duchess Natasha's previous life.

The words she said to him were — "Ugh. Villainess."

She's talking about me, isn't it? What this place? Is this the plot of an otome game? Or a romance novel? What kind of world is this?

Her feelings in turmoil, Natasha tries to get away from her fiancé the prince to avoid the bad ending, but…!

A fantasy romance between a reincarnated villainess who is an excellent cook and her childhood friend, the prince!

(Source: Melissa, translated)

title.native: 邪魔者のようですが、王子の昼食は私が作るようです
title.romaji: Jamasha no You desu ga, Ouji no Chuushoku wa Watashi ga Tsukuru You desu

171100.description:
Strangely, the women who get in Sangchul's taxi open up to him both mentally and physically. Will the woman of his dreams do the same for him when she becomes his customer?

(Source: Toomics)

171101.description:
Some may think it's a problem, but I can't help myself... I'm crazy for it!

(Source: Toomics)

title.native: 外れスキル『コンビニ』で最強の勇者に成り上がる！～異世界でコンビニ生活を満喫しつつ、オレを追放したクラスメイトを見返す事にしました～
title.romaji: Hazure Skill "Konbini" de Saikyou no Yuusha ni Nariagaru: Isekai de Konbini Seikatsu wo Mankitsu Shitsutsu, Ore wo Tsuihou Shita Classmate wo Mikaesu Koto ni Shimashita

171103.description:
An anthology featuring masters of the horror genre. Also includes editorial comics depicting "black humor" and essays on Japanese horror media.

1. Ikisudama (生霊) [Sasaya Nanae]
2. Chikatetsu wo Orite (地下鉄を降りて) [Daijiro Morohoshi]
3. Uchi no Mama wa Sekai Ichi (うちのママは世界一) [Tatsuhiko Yamagami]
4. Susumu-chan Daishokku (ススムちゃん大ショック) [Go Nagai]
5. Happyaku Bikuni (八百比丘尼) [Ryoko Yamagishi]
6. Nenne... Shina (ねんね…しな) [Masako Watanabe]

title.native: 怖い話 傑作マンガ選

171104.description:
Liana Theodore was a maid who knew her place. Knowing their difference in status, she was determined to bury her love for Prince Illyd. But when Illyd awakens as a Manish with fiery powers, Liana is found to be his Aradhna--his salvation from madness and his destined other half. Can Liana conquer her new life? Or will she be ensnared in his grasp?

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: The Maid Holds the Tyrant's Leash

171105.description:
What is the future with my current boyfriend — marriage or breakup? Is my happiness still waiting for me out there beyond this bittersweet love?

(Source: Ganma!, translated)

title.native: オトナの恋を甘くして

171106.description:
Kondo leads her junior high school life trying keeping a low profile. Sitting in front of her is Takahashi, who comes to school every morning with a sleepy look and goes about his day in his own way. One thing leads to another, and the two grow closer… This is a tender and bittersweet story of adolescence.

(Source: Kurage Bunch, translated)

171107.description:
In the winter of her second year of high school, Natsumi is about to get braces for her teeth, while starting to worry about the university entrance examinations that are a year away.

(Source: Comic Action, translated)

171108.description:
Six up-and-coming female artists adapt Atukagawa and Oe awards-winning author Yu Nagashima's stories into manga.

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

1. 三の隣は五号室, Sumako Kari
2. もう生まれたくない. Misato Konari
3. 今も未来も変わらない, Niwa Tanba
4. 問いのない答え, Kaori Tsurutani
5. 舟, Hanna Mimoto
6. 三十歳, Kyo Yoneshiro

title.native: いろんな私が本当の私
title.romaji: Iron na Watashi ga Hontou no Watashi

synonyms: The Film Emperor Is Dead Set on Becoming My Backer
The Film Emperor, He Insisted on Being My Patron
The Movie King Wants to be My Financier
年下わんことヤンデレに執着されています

title.romaji: Yingdi Ta Ying Yao Dang Wo Jin Zhu

171113.description:
In the magical world of Lockenheim, the Demon Lord Barbados and the hero Cygnar, rivals by fate, ripped open a space-time rift with their fierce battle, and the Demon Lord's entire castle is transported into our modern world.

And, to their surprise, the place where they landed just happens to the building site for a future condo in Tokyo's Koto Ward!

Our savvy (?) Demon Lord decides to rent out his castle as apartments. Now the Demon Lord must face the daily struggles of being a landlord in this new real estate comedy!

(Source: Dengeki Maoh, translated)

title.native: 魔王城、空き部屋あります！

synonyms: 우자키 양은 놀고 싶어! If 우자키 일가 코믹 앤솔러지

title.native: 宇崎ちゃんは遊びたい！ If 宇崎家コミックアンソロジー
title.romaji: Uzaki-chan wa Asobitai!! If Uzaki-Ke Comic Anthology

title.native: 異世界でビッチな女神様の信者を増やす簡単なお仕事です
title.romaji: Isekai de Bitch na Megami-sama no Shinja wo Fuyasu Kantan na Oshigoto desu

171117.description:
An innocent boy in a rural village gradually becomes tainted by his relationship with an imprisoned old woman and a man who is obsessed with the construction of a music hall… One day, as the boy was going about his day, a girl suddenly appears and tells him that he must evacuate the village…!

(Source: Shonengahosha, translated)

title.native: ママでセックスの練習しなさい！
title.romaji: Mama de Sex no Renshuu Shinasai!

title.native: 再会した母は女にしか見えなかった
title.romaji: Saikai shita Haha wa Onna ni Shika Mienakatta

171122.description:
En and Touma, two young boys who compete and push each other to excel in martial arts to host the proof of their mastery, a spirit beast. One day, En successfully hosts the spirit beast, but he becomes the target of enemies who desire it. At that moment, what will Touma do?

(Source: Kagurabachi Wiki)

title.native: さらば！チェリーボーイ！

171124.description:
Ota-kun is being bullied. Yamagishi-san, who sits in front of him, can't bear to see it and starts exchanging letters with him. Ota-kun decides to give Yamagishi-san a hand-knitted bracelet as a birthday present, but...!?

(Source: Kagurabachi Wiki)

171125.description:
Ai is going to choir camp at the time where she 5 years ago saw her fated love. When she finds her fated love, a boy named Motoki, she is surprised to learn that he is deaf and communicates through sign language and lip reading. As they grow closer she commits herself to learning sign language so that the two can communicate unhindered. But the jealous girl Misaki is trying to get in her way...

1. Kikoemasu ka Ai! (きこえますか愛！)
2. Hoshizora Ichi-gou Kan (星空1号館)
3. Sangatsu no Peter Pan (3月のピーターパン)

171126.description:
The world is full of oddities that people just don’t notice. William Valentine probably wouldn’t take note of them either... if he wasn’t assistant to the insensible Eric Hartman, a professional record-keeper of the bizarre. Join these two 9-to-5 gentlemen on their unlikely adventures in search of strange things.

(Source: Tapas)

171127.description:
Otogiri Tobi, a 2nd grade middle school student, spends his depressing days searching for his missing older brother alongside his inhuman companion, Baku. Tobi used to rarely speak to anyone besides Baku, however one day after his classmate Shiratama Ryuuko suddenly approaches him, his life begins to change...? This is an adventure surrounding the "human" and the "inhuman" that a lone boy faces.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

171128.description:
Julitan is a cook who's never left his tiny fishing village. That is until one day, when he slices open the belly of a giant fish and finds a mysterious lady sleeping inside, cradling a giant sword. Julitan bestows her with the name Carnelian, only to accidentally awaken a powerful "sille" being. But Carnelian the sille soon discovers her new tamer and master Sir Julitan is no match for her superior power. Now the two must embark on a long quest to find this fierce sille dragon's true knight!

(Source: Tapas)

171129.description:
One day at a tea party, the marquess Iris is suddenly told that her engagement has been called off. She loses her fiancé to her beautiful half-sister. In addition, she is married off to Baron Lucas, a wealthy merchant who is rumored to be a ruthless businessman and a womanizer, in exchange for paying her family's debts… This is a story about how a political marriage turns into a doting love story!

(Source: Magcomi, translated)

title.native: 婚約破棄された『空気』な私、成り上がりの旦那様に嫁ぎました。 THE COMIC
title.romaji: Konyaku Haki sareta "Kuuki" na Watashi, Nari Agari no Danna-sama ni Totsugimashita THE COMIC

171131.description:
A runaway noble lady, now a maid at an inn.

Meryl Parte, the Count's only daughter, escapes an unwanted marriage and flees to Harp Island to keep a promise to her late mother. After a night at the rundown inn Dragondaily, she wakes up penniless and in bed with a mysterious man! He offers to help her, but only if she works as the inn's maid!

(Source: Manta)

171132.description:
U-Jin is the only man working in the kindergarten. While working as a driver, he learns about the special power of the mysterious app.

"I can control both teachers and parents with this? Things are going to get fun around here."

(Source: DAYcomics, edited)

171133.description:
"Please take care of my girl while I'm away, Kevin."

Those were James's last words.

(Source: Toomics)

171134.description:
The strongest knight meets a young saint with extraordinary power…

In the Kingdom of Nave, the princess is six years old and born blind. She lives in the "Forest of Lent," far from the royal capital, because the king was worried about her being drawn into political disputes. But now the king dispatches Sirius, vice-captain of the Unicorn Knights, to "bring her home."

(Source: Comic EarthStar, translated)

title.native: 転生した大聖女は、聖女であることをひた隠す ZERO　～The Great Saint of Remembrance～
title.romaji: Tensei Shita Dai Seijo wa, Seijo de aru koto wo Hitakakusu ZERO: The Great Saint of Remembrance

171135.description:
It’s three hundred years before Fia and her friends’ adventures in Náv, and Princess Serafina, the blind second princess of the land, lives hidden away in the forest. With only the forest spirits and her cousin, the young knight captain Sirius Ulysses, to keep her company, Serafina leads a peaceful life. But one day, an incident causes mysterious powers to awaken within her, and Serafina takes her first steps on the path that will ultimately lead her to becoming the one and only Great Saint!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title.english: A Tale of the Secret Saint ZERO
title.native: 転生した大聖女は、聖女であることをひた隠す ZERO
title.romaji: Tensei shita Dai Seijo wa, Seijo de Aru Koto wo Hita Kakusu ZERO

171136.description:
"I'm going to tell you I love you every day!"

A junior boy confesses his love at first sight! A bumpy love story between a puppy-dog boy and a tomboy girl begins—

(Source: Ganma!, translated)

title.english: I Offer My Manliness To You

171137.description:
A love story starting with "I hate you!"?!

She's a tough secretary who takes no bullshit from anyone, including her boss. He's the company's handsome and cunning vice president, who she can't stand, until he suddenly offers her a contract marriage. She agrees, ready to exploit it to her benefit, but her secretly perverted boss seems to have ulterior motives as well.

title.native: 世にも劣悪なエリート婚
title.romaji: Yo ni mo Retsuaku na Elite-kon

171138.description:
In nineteenth century London, deep in the East End, there live the Hooligans: a band of miscreants led by alchemist Lee Heartrib, the current head of the Antilia Family mafia. Entrusted with guardianship of the city by his predecessor, Lee uses his alchemy to keep the junkies happy—but his true aim is creating a “paradise” for the good of the people. And sometimes, that involves getting his hands dirty, especially when he’s pitted against the other mafia heads, or shadowy beings who want to eliminate human life on earth.

A new world order is on the horizon, with the Hooligans leading the way!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title.native: 恥辱痴感〜淫らに喘ぐ女たち
title.romaji: Chijoku Chikan: Midara ni Aegu Onna-tachi

171140.description:
Born to be a princess, Fine was raised in a tower with a blindfold on because of her golden eyes, which are said to be unlucky. Though she believed her parents loved her, it all turned out to be a lie when her father decides to offer her to the god to end the kingdom's long- standing drought. But right before Fine is pushed into the spring, the king of the powerful kingdom Stichtite, Sieghart rescues her. "I want to make Fine my wife." Fine is utterly confused by both the relief of having her life saved and his sudden request. Why did he save Fine and ask her to marry him when they've never met? Will Fine be able to find out Sieghart's true goal?

(Source: POCKET COMICS)
synonyms: 孤高王與被幽禁的公主

title.english: The Isolated King and the Imprisoned Princess
title.native: 孤高の王は囚われの姫から愛を知る
title.romaji: Kokou no Ou wa toraware no Hime Kara Ai wo Shiru

171141.description:
Because of her unlucky golden eyes, Feine is offered up as a sacrifice to the gods. However, just before she is about to be drowned in a fountain, she catches the eye of King Sieghart of the Stichtites, who takes her home as his bride. Sieghart, who seems incapable of real love, asks her to become his wife and bear his child in exchange for her life. Feine becomes attracted to Sieghart, who treats her tenderly, but she hides her true feelings so as not to become a burden to him…

(Source: Gabriella Bunko, translated)

title.native: 孤高の王は囚われの姫から愛を知る
title.romaji: Kokou no Ou wa toraware no Hime Kara Ai wo Shiru

171142.description:
Mayu just started going out with a boy she likes. However, she is already addicted to sex with her dad. If she keeps doing this, it will definitely hurt the relationship with her boyfriend. Can she stop fucking her own father? Or…

(Source: Toranoana, translated)
synonyms: I Really Have to Stop This.

title.native: やめなくてはいけない。

171143.description:
I am Ellie, 17 years old. I am a member of "Avanture," a group of drifters who protect Rocktown from the Enders, a threat to mankind. My childhood friend Kanata found a mysterious magus "Noir", and another diva magus "Ciel" has appeared. What should I do? I don't want to get in the way of Kanata and his friends, but look my way once in a while, won't you! It would be easier if I could be honest about my feelings. I'm trying to cook, dress up, lose weight, and my partner Magus Ange comforts me. I won't give up so easily!

A must-read for fans of the animated TV series SYNDUALITY Noir. A spin-off story about Ellie's love affair in full bloom!

(Source: MF Bunko, translated)

171146.description:
After losing both her parents and her inheritance, all Gu Mang had left was her younger brother. Finally cut off from even her despicable uncle's charity, a new opportunity to get in good with an affluent CEO gives her the shot she needs to provide for her sibling. And shoving this new connection in the face of her corrupt family is definitely a bonus!

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: Madam and Her Daily Online Face-Slapping
Cool Madam Proves Others Wrong Online

title.romaji: Furen Mei Tian Dou Zai Xian Da Lian

171147.description:
When the idol Chico announced her retirement, Yamada-san, her biggest fan, felt an overwhelming sense of loss. But then a new office lady joins her workplace, and it turns out to be the former idol herself…!?

(Source: Shonen Jump Plus, translated)
synonyms: I Became the Superior of My Favorite Idol Who Retired

title.native: 引退した推しの上司になりました
title.romaji: Intai Shita Oshi no Joshi ni Narimashita

171148.description:
The original author of Zenbu Kimi no Sei creates a completely original after story. You can read it without any worries even if you don't know the original work. It is a loving romantic comedy between two university students.

(Source: Toranoana, Translated)
synonyms: A Story about a Couple That Can Become Either Gender Intending to Go to a Hot Spring but Accidentally Going to a Love Hotel (All Because of You)

title.native: 男にも女にもなるカップルが温泉旅行のつもりでラブホに行く話
title.romaji: Otoko ni mo Onna ni mo Naru Couple ga Onsen Ryokou no Tsumori de Rabuho ni Iku Hanashi

171149.description:
Je-Hyeok, a priest who repents of his childhood as a bully and lives for God, receives a necklace as a reward for the confession.
As soon as he puts on the necklace, Je-Hyeok's body heats up and a counselor approaches. Playing with and teasing the priest's erect penis, he reveals that he is an outcast who was bullied by the priest during his school days...

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue

171150.description:
One day, Kang Ju-Han, the president of Hakcheonpa, receives an unpleasant package. Inside the box was an old, broken rope. Ju-Han, who thought he might be one of the perverts who had always been interested in him, goes to the address written on the delivery box to seek revenge. In an abandoned factory in a deserted corner, a man, Seo Jeong-U, attacks Ju-Han from behind as he looks around. Jeong-U wraps a rope around Ju-Han's neck and tightens it. Ju-Han felt strange as he was being strangled. Jeong-U, who notices that Ju-Han has an erection, lets out an awkward laugh. Unlike Ju-Han, who thinks it's just a physiological phenomenon, Jeong-U realizes how he can make Kang Ju-Han, who is only proud, miserable. Kang Ju-Han is forced to have sex with Jeong-U. He curses and rejects Jeong-U, but at the same time, he is overwhelmed by the pleasure he feels for the first time.

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue chapter
synonyms: [Dominion VS Roll Short Stories] TURN UP

171151.description:
A story about a childhood friend with an unbelievable secret.

Note: Originally published in the 2023 November issue of Gangan JOKER.
synonyms: This Girl Is Probably Committing Tax Evasion

title.native: たぶん彼女は脱税してる

171152.description: Note: Chapter count includes one prologue chapter
synonyms: [Dominion VS Roll Short Stories] How to Use a Man's Necktie

title.romaji: [Gullim VS Gullim Danpyeonseon] Geu Namjaui Necktie Sayongbeop

171153.description: Note: Chapter count includes a prologue chapter
synonyms: [Dominion VS Roll Short Stories] Garden Secret

171154.description: Lillyshia, who had been oppressed as the "Princess of Scars," was pushed down from the balcony one day, and when she woke up, she was 10 years old! When she decides to be happy this time, she meets Ethan, a boy who was injured like she used to be!
synonyms: The Scarred Princess's Pursuit of Happiness

title.native: 傷痕王子妃は幸せになりたい
title.romaji: Kizuato Oujihi wa Shiawase ni Naritai

171155.description:
For years, Park Ji-Woon has been quietly in love with Kang Soo-Hyuk. Soo-Hyuk notices Ji-Woon’s feelings and begins to use him like a toy, indulging his own desires without restraint. As long as he can stay close to Soo-Hyuk, Ji-Woon tells himself that being used is better than nothing. But Soo-Hyuk’s cold and careless treatment slowly wears him down. Then one day, Ji-Woon receives a mysterious package. Inside the box, he finds a strange cord and a note. Taking it as his last hope, he decides to try using the cord on Soo-Hyuk. From that moment on, something feels different.

“Trash like you deserves to be punished and taught a lesson. So obey me.”

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: [Gullim VS Gullim Danpyeonseon] Electric Reverse Love

171156.description:
A collection of 4-koma about the author's pet cats: Ryu, Yume and Jasu.

Note: Released in Poland as the 4th volume of Nikukyuu Punipuni Nikki.

title.native: 肉球プニプニ日記 おなかもふもふ編

171157.description: Note: Chapter count includes a prologue chapter
synonyms: [Dominion VS Roll Short Stories] Cure ♡ Touch

title.english: When I Was Fapping With My Super-Handsome Pal, We Began Fucking Before I Knew It!
title.native: 超絶美少年の友達と一緒にオナニーしてたらいつの間にかシテた
title.romaji: Chouzetsu Bishounen no Tomodachi to Issho ni Onanie Shitetara Itsunomanika Shiteta

171159.description:
Rookie actor Lee Yu-myeong was cast in star director Park Jae-jin’s movie ‘Let Me Shine’. As a former swimmer, he had never achieved what he wanted on time in his life. After he gave up his dream of becoming a child actor, he took up swimming, and by the time he quit his career, he was an actor again. The same was true in his love life. That won’t stop them from conducting nightly rituals to entice him into their dreams, though, or listing out what exactly they like about him, down to the very last organ. 171285.description:
Akadacho is a rural town surrounded by mountains on all sides. Shiori Nakagawa is suppose to be a student at the high school in town, but he has been skipping school because of bullying. One day, Mei Sato moves into Shiori's house as a renter. The normally reticent Mei tells only Shiori the true purpose of her visit to this town.

"I want to kill the seven people who forced my sister to her death."

Three years ago, Mei's older sister Akari was bullied so severely in this town that she took her own life. Mei has returned here to avenge her death. She plans to kill the seven bullies by performing a bloody ritual called "Okakashitsumi," a tradition at the Akada Shrine, to summon the spirit of the snake god "Okakashi-Sama" into her body. On the night of the summer solstice, Mei succeeds in the ritual. One by one, she and Shiori, with the help of the god's powers, kill the people involved in her sister's death. During their days of revenge and escape, the two develop romantic feelings for each other. However, Mei is hiding something from Shiori. The person who performs "Okakakatsutsumi" must offer her soul to the god in exchange. In other words, "Mei's death" is inevitable.

171371.description: The plot of the series revolves around three youkai, Bem, Bella and Bello, who arrive at a large coastal city and come across an evil atmosphere, which was brought about by immoral behavior by humans and mischief caused by monsters and youkai. They therefore decide to stay in the city, fighting against other monsters and youkai which attack humans, making a few friends along the way. Even though the three youkai are often abused and discriminated against by other human beings due to their appearance, they still strive in protecting the human populace of the city from other monsters, one day hoping to become human beings in return for their good actions.

171378.description:
About 2,700 years ago, in ancient China, Qi, there were two children who were making a living by trading. A girl and a boy. After helping an old man who was about to be framed for an unfounded crime, the two got acquainted with a person involved in the politics of this country, and became an official to change this corrupt country.

However, the time is ancient China... women are not allowed to become government officials. With the risk of her execution if discovered, Naka disguises her gender and serves as a man.

Based on the Chinese historical idiom "Fellowship of Guan Abalone" as a motif, a new sense of authentic Chinese court romance drawn with a completely new interpretation... The grand opening!!

Today, I found out my friend is having an affair with a married man. Then, I discovered my own husband is cheating on me. I've always looked down on people like that, convinced I'd never become one of them. But recently... I've met someone who makes my heart race.

Is this love?

171380.description:
Leila is a woman who used to work in an office. Now, she's suddenly fallen into a new fantasy world called "The Dragon Kingdom." While falling out of the sky, she was saved by a giant dragon and decided that from now on her name is Lylac. Now she will live in the castle of the King of this nation, the Dragon Lord, and have the opportunity to work. However... the workers never take breaks and are constantly overworked! Lylac, with her kitchen servant status and knowledge of modern cooking, tries to get the staff to take breaks and enjoy lunchtime meals! In the midst of positive change in the kitchen, Lylac's soup dish accidentally gets sent to the Dragon Lord himself?! Lylac was prepared for the worst, but in audience with the Dragon Lord is told "make this soup for me every day from now on." What?! The Dragon Lord now has a taste for Lylac's cooking! An alluring fantasy story of friendships, romance, and delicious food!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

171392.description:
A bad fall awakened Selina Elsner to the truth… she’s been reborn into a novel! It also gave her a cruel realization—she’s a no-name side character! She barely even had any lines! As if that’s not bad enough, Louis Bloomberg, the evil lord of the magic tower, fancies her! He’s a sorcerer so powerful that his magic speaks darkness in his mind! Assuming his lost equipment was sold, he’s hoping that as blacksmith Zig, it will come back to him through repairs and lead him to the hacker. After breaking many swords, however, he finds this is no walk in the park. Thankfully, he’s able to see cracks in the equipment and enemies that show their vital points to make or break them! 171422.description:
Harumi works as a beauty consultant for a cosmetics company, but his poor customer service skills stop him from making any progress. He finds himself frustrated day in and day out. The one thing he loves more than anything are the beauty videos made by his favorite online beauty streamer, Sakaki. But watching Sakaki's cross-dressing and men's makeup tutorials, Harumi finds himself so entranced that he just can't help but jerk himself off, which fills him with even more self-loathing. One day, Harumi sees his idol in the store he works at, and even gets the chance to help him try on some makeup. As he applies Sakaki's lipstick, Harumi is caught between the greatest happiness of his life and his own crushing sense of guilt... Which one will win out!?

(Source: Renta!)

After failing the auditions for a role he'd been preparing for, Lyle takes a trip to Korea for a change of pace. As a black-footed cat-man, he was not able to present himself as a top amongst the larger beastmen, but having travelled to this place with all sorts of small and cute animals that suited his tastes, he thinks he could be a top here. After downloading an online dating app, Lyle starts chatting with a rabbit-man with the handle "Kkyu," and steadily grows fond of him. Finally, the day they meet arrives! However, what appears before Lyle, as his heart pounds, is...a brute-like rabbit...?!

"Is this person...really my Kkyu...?!"

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

Note: Includes five extra chapters.

171424.description:
Introducing the noisy neighbor of your nightmares: a Youtuber.

It's been six months since broody auto-mechanic Kumazawa moved in next door to Koichi, a streamer who claims to be an expert on love. After one too many loud recordings, Kumazawa finally snaps and shows up at Koichi's door... only to shut him up with a passionate kiss!

Kumazawa has no interest in pursuing a straight guy, but Koichi stops by night after night and won't leave until he's "satisfied." Coming off the heels of a traumatic breakup in which his partner cheated, Kumazawa is convinced he and Koichi won't work out, but Koichi is determined to persuade him otherwise. Can a physical relationship between two people who are totally NOT "meant to be" turn into something real...?

(Source: TOKYOPOP)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

171425.description:
As a high-ranking general captured after the end of a war, the Holy Knight Gilbert braces for execution... when at the last moment, his life is saved by Chris, the enemy nation's master artificer and puppeteer. An arrogant, wickedly playful man who surrounds himself only with dolls of his own making, Chris claims to admire the beauty of Gilbert's soul and intends to use him to create his newest masterpiece.

When Gilbert refuses to go along with Chris's plan, he is forced to choose between certain death and forsaking his faith to become an immortal doll. Hoping to buy enough time to make his escape, Gilbert instead offers himself up to Chris as a slave. But if that's the game this knight wishes to play, then Chris fully intends on toying with him until Gilbert breaks to his will...

(Source: TOKYOPOP)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.english: The Genius Puppeteer Loves the Holy Knight Fiercely

Sakura is a Millennial who's already been divorced. Despite being the chief of the sales department, he struggles to build a working relationship with Aoi, a new Gen Z employee. Ryota and Tomoya have a past together, though, that goes beyond the office walls...

(Source: Renta!)

When she arrives and meets her biological father, her life is turned upside down once again as she’s forced to live the life of Rozenta Estella, the sole heir to the Estella estate and the only son of the Duke of Estella. Through the power of magical artifacts, she's able to live the life of Rozenta, a supporting male character from a novel she once read in a previous life. She decides to embrace this new life as the familiar narrative unfolds before her. Despite knowing the overall story and its characters, she's surprised that the male and female leads have not become the characters she's read about. Although Rozenta Estella was just a minor character in the original novel, Rosa learns to navigate the intricacies of his life and family while fostering a budding friendship with Theodore and Vivian. Her happiness doesn't last very long as all three grow up and enter the roles they've been born into.

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

171643.description:
It's A Miraculous Win (奇跡の勝ちは) is a series of Evangelion spin-off manga released in fourteen volumes from 2006 to 2015. It is set in a world where Eva is a fictional franchise, and the main character is an "Office Lady", aged 24, called Sakura Mogami (最上さくら) who loves to play Evangelion pachinko. She is a lively but clumsy young woman, defined by her obsession with everything Evangelion-related, and owns multiple Evangelion merchandise.

This is a light comedy manga that follows Sakura's misadventures and daily suffering as an obsessed Eva fan, as she frequently reminisces over scenes from the anime series, and even relives some of them in daily life. She also works with several people that happen to look exactly like some Evangelion cast members like Ritsuko, and her boss, who looks like Fuyutsuki. Mogami herself cosplays Rei and Asuka, and has a design similar to Gunbuster's Noriko. Notably, Mogami dates a pachinko parlor employee who looks exactly like Kaworu. She seems to be designed as a sort of self-insert character for female fans, parodying their own lives in a sort of wish-fulfillment setting that resembles the real world.

This entry is for the 1st volume of the series.

It was near the end of the Showa period (1926-1989), before the "Gangster Law" was enacted, when yakuza were still able to make a living through violence. 18-year-old Taro Sato was leading an aimless life, with no dreams or goals, when he was recruited by chance to become the driver for a yakuza boss. Suddenly plunged into gangster life, can Taro become a "wiseguy" like his boss?

This is a genuine yakuza story that pursues realism to the extreme!

After her show, singer and radio host Ban Ha-Na receives a cassette player from a fan. But being just one among many gifts, she doesn’t think much of it-- that is, until the press of a button sends her to the 80s! There, she meets the cassette player’s owner, who happens to be the late musician U Jae-A. However, Ha-Na meets him at a time when he hasn’t yet become famous and is on the verge of quitting music. Will she be able to convince her idol not to give up on his dream and save his life?

Kei is a university student who's popular with the ladies but is never considered to be a genuine romantic prospect. One day, a succubus named Ema suddenly appears before him! Ema claims to have been summoned there because of a contract formed by Kei, but Kei knows nothing about it. Ignoring Kei's confusion, Ema focuses on his mission of "seducing Kei and stealing his soul" and immediately starts trying to have sex with him, but for some reason...?!

171787.description:
Kwon Ha-Ra is just an ordinary high schooler until she is summoned to the world of Tatara, where she meets her favorite book character, Tori Veriharts. Although star-struck by Tori, she desperately wants to return home to her beloved mother. The only way back, she is told, is to become the successor of the powerful lightning stone and defeat the evil wizard, Parus. With no other choice, Ha-Ra and Tori set out on an electrifying adventure to save Tatara and return home!

(Source: Tapas, edited)

Unless she can figure out where this story is going, Elena is in a world of trouble... or is it the world that’s in trouble because of her?

Three years after the completion of "Maeumuisori", Cho Seok's daily life will be revealed! The title is... "Just draw a comic". (But I know everyone will call it "Maeumuisori 2")

(Source: Naver Webtoon, translated)

171804.description:
A life in the spotlight is a dream for many...but it's behind the scenes where the real drama takes place. Baek Yeong-Woon plays manager for Seo Hae-Yul, an up-and-coming actor at All One Pictures with a secret: his success is fueled by an industry "sponsor" who loves more than just his talent. So when a love affair between the young star and a mysterious figure threatens the livelihood of their company, it is up to Yeong-Woon to track his client down and put an end to their risky romp. But the truth may be too much for him to bear, as the other party turns out to be top model—and Yeong-Woon's first love—Han Seo-In. As Yeong-Woon struggles to reconcile his unresolved feelings for Seo-In with his sense of duty toward his work, the two fall into a intricate web woven of unanswered questions and lingering emotions that changes the trajectory of their lives forever...

(Source: Lezhin, edited)

171806.description:
Hae Jin has a father who devoted his whole life to finding the national artifacts that were smuggled out of the country. Then one day, after receiving an unknown “artifact” sent by his father, whom he had lost contact with for a long time, a strange light suddenly came from it, granting Hae Jin a mysterious power and a mission.

“The magic of the Heavenly Object has been bestowed upon you.”

Thus, an adventure involving the artifacts scattered all over the world, including the "Three Heavenly Objects," which contain the soul of the Korean people, begins!

(Source: Naver, translated)

171808.description:
One day, Watase, a university student, comes across a cat vandalizing the flower beds of the Agriculture Department. Unfortunately, they were seen by Kashiwagi, an eccentric senior agriculture student.

Kashiwagi, who is devoted to plant research, makes disturbing threats to the cat, and Watase panics and says "I'll do anything, but please forgive the cat." At first, Watase has to follow Kashiwagi's orders and do chores, but he gradually becomes attracted to Kashiwagi, despite his unpredictable behavior. And then he finds out that Kashiwagi is gay, too.

(Source: ShuCream, translated)

171810.description:
From a young age, I've always dreamed of being that “unassuming hero,” appearing ordinary but possessing unmatched strength. But one day, fate took a turn when I was hit by an eight-ton truck, and suddenly, reincarnation was on the table! "What would you like to be in your next life?" asked the goddess of reincarnation. Eagerly, I replied, "I wish to become a wimp, but secretly OP!” She granted my wish, but with an unexpected twist: if anyone ever uncovers my true abilities, my heart will explode! This isn't quite the “secretly-OP-wimp-life” I had in mind…

(Source: WEBTOON)

171811.description:
Toraya is a serious, modest office worker with one secret he can't let slip: he's really, really horny! After yet another day of exhausting work, his pent-up stress and libido get the better of him, and he heads to the office bathroom to take matters into his own hands…only for Saikawa, his least favorite supervisor, to catch him in the act. Toraya hopes they can both just forget about it, but Saikawa wants something in exchange for his silence…

(Source: Yen Press)

One fateful day, Signatur Zegar's worst nightmare comes true when he unwittingly forges a pact with Minerva and Sui, two eccentric demonic swords donning a teenage girl guise. Setting forth on a quest to break the binding contract, Sig, along with his newfound companions, navigates through a web of conspiracies and unexpected challenges. As the journey unfolds, the pressing question remains: Can Sig break free from their bond, or is he destined to be forever entangled with these demonic blades?

(Source: Tapas)

171816.description:
Five years have passed since a blameless infant was spared from a demonstration, saved by her parents' self-sacrifice. Yet what should have ended the religious hysteria has instead fueled a new wave of feverish cult practices by the ever-growing Arrowhead. As society teeters on the brink of further chaos and long-dead sinners inexplicably begin returning to life, the government steps in behind the scenes to tip the scales.

(Source: WEBTOON)

After being scouted for the necromancer’s academy, this genius is ready to be nurtured and taken to the next level. But could Simon’s insane talents attract some unforeseen consequences?

(Source: Tapas)

Despite this deadly paradox, Eun-Seong still believes they are meant to be together, and this time he won't let anything get in his way...

title.native: てぺとる！～てっぺんとったる！～

171983.description:
Yuuya starts his dream of living alone. Then Sera, a famous beautiful girl at school and his self-proclaimed ex-girlfriend, and her younger sister Rise rush in. In order for the three of them to be self-sufficient, an exciting life together begins where they grow vegetables in their home garden and eat delicious food!

(Source: Comic Days, translated)

171985.description:
I want to see you today and tomorrow...

Saku is a college student who wants a love like something out of a girls' comic, yet he struggles because he's a good communicator but keeps being broken up with because he doesn't "act like a boyfriend." Misumi, a hot student at his university who's highly popular with the girls, takes an interest in Saku and draws close to him. Misumi accepts Saku's views on love without laughing at him. Before Saku knows it, Misumi is coming to see him all the time. Misumi's words and actions make Saku's heart skip a beat, so Saku does his best to learn from the master. Before he knows it, he finds himself genuinely falling for Misumi!

(Source: GUSH COMICS)
synonyms: I will go to see you again tomorrow.

title.english: I'll Go to See You Again Tomorrow
title.native: 明日もきみに会いに行く
title.romaji: Ashita mo Kimi ni Ai ni Iku

171986.description:
In the year 2020, elves, whose original forest homes were burned to the ground, are now living in Kanagawa Prefecture, near Tokyo. They're living in Yokohama, Yokosuka, Chigasaki, Sagamihara...... and various other places, out in the open. This is an urban fantasy comedy about the "elves of Kanagawa," who have completely adapted to modern Japan, centering on childhood friends, the "Yokohama elf" and the "Kawasaki man"!

(Source: Micro Magazine, translated)

171987.description: An adaptation of Kim Cheol-Gon's fantasy novel S.K.T

synonyms: They Always Fight Like Cats and Dogs

title.native: 俺が猫ならお前は犬で
title.romaji: Ore ga Neko nara Omae wa Inu de

171990.description:
Endymion passed the interview to finally become a Swallow Knight because he’s... cute? His lifelong dream has turned out to be nothing like what he had expected. He thought knights were supposed to be honorable and tough! But there is also good news: his past experience as a party host may come in handy after all. How will his life change as he becomes a Swallow Knight?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

171991.description:
Ryuusei is tasked to be the star in a prank video in an attempt to go viral. His objective? Confess to his friend from his yankee days, Sawami! Ryuusei shies away from the idea of making the man he admires the butt of a joke, but he's intrigued to see how Sawami would react and reluctantly accepts. He tells himself he'll be satisfied if he gets a laugh out of him, but his friend's response is unexpectedly serious!

(Source: Julian Publishing, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: きみは愛しのライアーボーイ
title.romaji: Kimi wa Itoshi no Liar Boy

171992.description:
In order to restore control on the finances of the shogunate, Arai Shiraishi, a close associate of the sixth shogun, Tokugawa Ienobu, selects Mizushiro Soshiro as the Shogun's account auditor. The samurai is initially bewildered by his new, unfamiliar role, but he comes to understand, when he is attacked by one assassin after another, as he tries to uncover corrupt officials who are lining their own pockets with the shogun's money.

(Source: Comic Border, translated)

171993.description:
In the Edo Period, two kids set out on the Tokaido Highway from Edo, without the permission of their parents or masters. Although their goal is the Ise Shrine, they also want to just travel around the country... A girl, Ichi, and a boy, Juu, travel along the Tokaido Highway to find their father in Ise.

(Source: LEED, translated)

Note: There are additional chapters not included in the volumes because the volume releases were canceled.

title.native: てくてく～東海道ぬけまいり～

171994.description:
Kuji Yakurou is a high school teacher who was cheated on and dumped by his girlfriend because of his "lack of masculinity." Shouldn't the world be beyond gender stereotypes by now? He is in anguish, when Akano, a model, influencer, high achiever, and president of the Biology Club, asks him to be the advisor of the Biology Club. She then begins to explain how "masculinity" is necessary to attract females, using the flamboyant feathers of a peacock as an example of "biology"...!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)
synonyms: It's just a story about peacocks.

title.native: あくまでクジャクの話です。

171995.description:
Hiro, a part-timer at a restaurant, is invited by his new manager to become a full-time employee due to his excellent performance. That night, someone breaks into the restaurant, attacks his manager, and kidnaps him. Hiro is also abducted in the process.When Hiro regains consciousness, he finds himself by a river in a mountainous area. There, he encounters a group of yakuza who kidnapped his manager for trivial reasons and tormented him.

(Source: Yawaraka Spirits, translated)
synonyms: アジール ～復讐の裏社会半グレ狩り～

171996.description:
Toru Kurusu is the captain of the basketball club. However, he is the only member of the club, and the club is on the verge of being abolished despite his desperate efforts to recruit new members. One day, he finds a boy stuck head-first in the basket. The boy, who has extraordinary jumping ability, says he wants to join the basketball club...?

(Source: Shonen Jump Plus, translated)
